lessons_used: Home new flow changes have proven helpful, winning 2 out of 10 tests.
Sign in redesign changes have proven helpful, winning 2 out of 8 tests.
Choose path redesign changes have proven helpful, winning 2 out of 3 tests.
Adoption layout changes have proven helpful, winning 1 out of 3 tests.
Finish hint, finish copy, home wait info, and home notification changes showed no clear effect across tests of those kinds.
Predictions were consistently too high across all round 1 tests.

candidates.title: Split layout pet selection experience on pick friend screen
candidates.change: Redesign the pick friend screen into a side-by-side split layout comparing pet archetypes with real-time trait previews.
candidates.why: Adoption drop-off is 27.6% with a median duration of 89s. Split layout redesigns in earlier steps showed positive conversion results.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Desktop Pet Companion
pick_friend.body: Select a friend to see how they will interact with your desktop and windows.

guard.reason: replacement for 'pick_friend.pet_choices' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Reorder sign in immediately after pet companion selection
candidates.change: Prompt account sign-in right after choosing a pet on pick_friend, securing pet progress before photo upload or certificate customization.
candidates.why: Sign-in currently happens later while 8 support tickets reported missing or reset pets after signing in. Securing identity right after pick_friend preserves selection.

sign_in.headline: Save Your New Pet to Your Account
sign_in.body: Sign in now to lock in your chosen pet companion and ensure automatic cloud recovery.
sign_in.hint: Signing in ensures your pet state is saved if you reinstall or switch devices.

guard.reason: Creates urgency to lock in the chosen pet.

candidates.title: Desktop display test and launcher verification new screen
candidates.change: Adds a dedicated desktop overlay test screen right after waiting to confirm the pet successfully renders on top of active desktop windows.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported pets not appearing on the desktop or the app failing to open upon onboarding completion.

new_desktop_verify.headline: Verify Desktop Overlay
new_desktop_verify.body: Can you see your pet walking on your screen? Confirm placement to complete desktop setup.

guard.reason: Valid addition of a verification screen inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Home drop-off is low (7.8%), supported by 3 emails. New screen cost is high and past new screen data in home is limited to 1 test.

candidates.title: Desktop pet sound voice chooser new screen in adoption
candidates.change: Adds a sound preview screen during adoption allowing users to sample and set companion voice effects before completing certificate.
candidates.why: Adoption has high drop-off (27.6%) and mean duration over 1000s; giving instant sound feedback increases adoption emotional investment.

new_pet_voice.headline: Choose Your Pet's Voice & Sounds
new_pet_voice.body: Pick how your pet reacts when you click or summon them on your desktop.

guard.reason: Valid addition of a sound customization screen inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Adoption loses 27.6% of users, but no support emails mention this feature and adoption new_screen has -0.8% historical lift across 6 tests.

candidates.title: Stage layout story screen redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the story introduction screen into a stage layout highlighting animated pet interactions before path selection.
candidates.why: Choose path screen conversion is 89.7% but users spend mean 514s; presenting a hero animation upfront speeds path decision.

story.headline: Meet Your Virtual Desktop Roommate
story.body: Your pet lives on your desktop, reacts to your windows, and keeps you company while you work.

guard.reason: replacement for 'story.intro_story' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'image', 'mascot', 'video'] with an asset:story/ asset

candidates.title: Centered layout pet recovery account sign in redesign
candidates.change: Redesign sign-in into a centered layout with prominent existing account recovery option and sync status check.
candidates.why: 8 users emailed support about missing or reset pets after signing in again, making account recovery clarity vital at sign in.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Restore Your Desktop Pet
sign_in.body: Log into your account to retrieve existing pets or back up your new companion.

guard.reason: 'sign_in.replace.sign_in_options[0]': a badge cannot do the sign_in_options job (use ['button', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'text'])

candidates.title: Existing pet cloud sync recovery hint on sign in
candidates.change: Display an explicit hint on the sign-in screen informing returning users that logging into the correct account restores existing pets.
candidates.why: 8 emails reported pets missing or reset after signing in again, indicating confusion around account switching vs fresh adoption.

sign_in.hint: Already adopted a pet? Sign into your original account to automatically restore your pet and settings.

guard.reason: Valid informational hint added to sign_in screen.

candidates.score_note: Strong support evidence (8 emails) and sign_in hints showed strong positive performance (+2.7% over 2 tests) at low implementation cost.

candidates.title: System initialization rendering activity wait info
candidates.change: Display active system rendering status and estimated time remaining on the waiting screen while desktop pet engine initializes.
candidates.why: Home waiting stage has a median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s; clear render info reduces user uncertainty during long waits.

waiting.body: Building desktop graphics pipeline and pet animation engine. Please keep app open.

guard.reason: Valid status and progress details added to waiting screen during actual initialization.

candidates.score_note: High wait duration in funnel, but home wait_info showed no clear effect (+0.6%) across past tests and lacks support email evidence.

candidates.title: Desktop companion name tag cosmetic badge incentive
candidates.change: Show a special custom collar name tag badge component on the finish intro screen upon completing onboarding.
candidates.why: Finish completion rate is only 64.8% (34.0% overall); offering a visual customization reward incentivizes reaching the final desktop state.

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions an unlocked cosmetic gift/extra.

candidates.title: Interactive control command quick tester new flow
candidates.change: Adds an interactive button checklist to home_intro allowing users to test hiding, minimizing, and chatting with the pet.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported post-onboarding confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet.

home_intro.headline: Try Out Your Desktop Pet Controls
home_intro.body: Test these 3 essential controls right now so you know how to manage your pet on your desktop.

home_welcome.label: Click to test: 1. Summon Pet  2. Hide to Tray  3. Open Chat Window

guard.reason: 'home_intro.replace.home_welcome[0].label' must be text up to 40 characters

picked: Desktop display test and launcher verification new screen
Existing pet cloud sync recovery hint on sign in

decisions.title: Desktop display test and launcher verification new screen
Existing pet cloud sync recovery hint on sign in
